Because the lantern burn is recorded at the falcon settlement, the quill audit makes public the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 68% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. The bill scales 30 fold, not the vote. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
